messages:
sam.c: Quick broadcast: next weekend (Sat 02:00-04:00 UTC) we're migrating CI auth away from repo-stored PATs + Okta app tokens to the new Identity Gateway (id-gw). This is a security + reliability push — please read the runbook: https://go.internal/id-gw/ci-migration

mira.s: Can you summarise the user-visible changes? who needs to test by when?

sam.c: TL;DR:
- Workflows MUST not rely on long-lived PATs in repo secrets. Any such secrets will be invalidated during cutover.
- Self-hosted runners will use the id-gw agent to exchange short-lived machine tokens. Upgrade to runner-agent v0.10.0.
- We add an org role `ci-runner` for mapped service accounts; repo owners will get invite emails to accept mappings.

leo.sec: Security note: rotate any user PATs in your secrets store before the window. We'll run an automated secrets scan after cutover and rotate flagged tokens.

devex-bot: Migration checklist PR template: https://go.internal/ci-migration-template. Please open PRs and tag @devex for quick reviews.

infra-oncall: Rollout plan: incremental canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with 15m observation windows. If auth error rate > 0.8% over baseline, we trigger fallback to Okta passthrough for 30m and investigate.

mira.s: How do teams test? is there a staging org?

sam.c: Yes: use `redwood-ci-canary` for staging. Run `./run-e2e.sh --org redwood-ci-canary --idg-test` and paste the logs here. Look for `token_exchange: success` and `runner.register: ok` lines.

ci-rollout-bot: Canary schedule: -00:45 UTC start. Gates: workflow_success_rate >= 99.5%, token_exchange_p95 < 500ms.

leo.sec: Service accounts: mapping table in the runbook. If you maintain infra service accounts, confirm theirs have least privilege and are not user-bound.

mira.s: Any immediate breakages to expect for Jira/GitHub app integrations?

sam.c: Most GitHub Apps remain unchanged. Webhooks and installed apps should be fine. Problems happen where workflows call out to the API using user PATs; those will error. Also callouts from external CI (third-party) may need reconfiguration.

infra-oncall: Monitoring panels to watch: `ci.auth.errors`, `runner.registration.latency`, `github.actions.failure_rate`, `webhook.delivery.errors`. Alerts: P1 pager, P2 slack.

mira.s: I'll run a readiness sweep Friday 18:00 UTC. Dev teams, please report results and open issues in this thread.

leo.sec: Post-migration: security will run an org-wide secrets audit and schedule forced rotation for tokens discovered in repos.

sam.c: Rollback runbook is in the doc — re-enable Okta passthrough and revoke newly minted tokens. We'll keep the fallback route live for 30m during the cutover.

devex-bot: Office hours: Sat 04:30 UTC in #eng-platform. Drop in if you see failures.

mira.s: Action items recap:
- Devs: run staging tests by Fri EOD; remove hardcoded PATs
- Runner owners: upgrade agent to v0.10.0
- Repo admins: review mappings and accept invites
- Security: pre-cutover audit and post-cutover rotation

sam.c: Thanks folks. Post blockers here and ping @infra-oncall for immediate help. :thumbsup:
